author: Soma Velayutham
description: A year ago, NVIDIA open sourced its Aerial wireless software, joining Sionna and a broader suite of open source tools for accelerating next-generation 6G network development. Together, they give researchers a foundation for testing ideas, comparing results and building on each other’s work — connecting simulation and AI training with experiments on real over-the-air wireless […]
title: How NVIDIA Open Source Tools Are Helping Researchers Build Next-Generation 6G Networks
